responsibility: Contains the scheduling description for AMD btver2 cores in the i386 backend. It defines btver2-specific decode classes, decode-to-macro-op resources, integer/AGU/FP units, vector-path blocking behavior, and detailed instruction reservations for integer, x87, SSE, and conversion operations, enabling GCC’s scheduler to model this Jaguar-family microarchitecture separately from Bulldozer and older AMD core descriptions.
